_comment: Anna Executa descriptor for the gamentic engine. The comms layer is app/executa.py (stdio JSON-RPC bridge over the unchanged FastAPI app). `anna-app dev` discovers this and spawns `command` (cwd = this dir); `anna-app executa publish` reads slug/name/version/distribution and mints the real tool_id.
name: Gamentic
description: Gamentic game engine, exposed as an Anna Executa. One tool, `request`, replays an HTTP-style call against the engine.

distribution._comment: binary = a PyInstaller --onefile bundle per platform in the layout the Anna Agent expects (per forum.anna.partners/t/.../140): the archive is <tool_id>-<platform>.tar.gz containing bin/<tool_id> + manifest.json whose runtime.binary.entrypoint.default points to bin/<tool_id>. Built by packaging/build-binary.sh, hosted on GitHub Releases. local = the dev-harness path. The frozen engine stores under EXECUTA_DATA. Only linux-x86_64 is built today; add macOS/Windows keys once CI (.github/workflows/executa-release.yml) produces them. Install on the agent via More -> Agents -> Install Essentials.
